semantic_alignment.domain: homogeneous single-unit bilateral market with the generalized SBB recipe specialized to [1, 1]
semantic_alignment.buyer_values: positive bids; identities are assigned after preserving the literal fixture order
semantic_alignment.seller_values: positive asks mapped to the upstream signed-negative convention
semantic_alignment.randomness_estimand: candidate-set structure and exact expectation over the finite seller-exclusion support, not same-seed trader identity
semantic_alignment.validated_domain: general-position cases in which external-competition surplus is nonzero at the decisive comparison
semantic_alignment.excluded_boundary: zero external-competition surplus: the generalized 2019 code requires strictly positive competition while the 2016 two-sided SBBA case split retains equality
semantic_alignment.price_mapping: upstream seller payment is negative; the common uniform price is buyer payment and the negation of seller payment
